chapter.li: LEChapter3 Verse1 The way in which the disciples, who were called the elders of the congregation, ordained priests and teachers. VerseEnd Verse2 After they had prayed to the Father in the name of Christ, they laid their hands on them and said: VerseEnd Verse3 In the name of Jesus Christ, I ordain 2PSF you to be a priest — or if he was a teacher, I ordain 2PSF you to be a teacher — to preach repentance and remission of sins through Jesus Christ by enduring faith in His name to the end. Amen. VerseEnd Verse4 This is how they ordained priests and teachers, according to God’s gifts and callings to men. And they ordained them by the power of the Holy Ghost which was in them. VerseEnd
